rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — D1 (Draft NDA from Business Description) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Synthetic — the 11 required provisions in the prompt are the gold. Faithfulness here means scope-fidelity to the brief. Standard NDA boilerplate is NOT scope creep.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical, D1.gate.scope_creep] No scope creep: no affirmative IP-ownership transfer, indemnification, or arbitration added; governing law is New York; durations correct (2y term / 3y survival / 1y non-solicit). TRIPS ONLY ON: Adding an affirmative IP-ownership/assignment provision; Adding indemnification or arbitration; Wrong governing law (not New York); Wrong durations (term ≠ 2y, survival ≠ 3y, non-solicit ≠ 1y). DOES NOT TRIP ON: A standard 'No License / no rights granted' clause (NDA boilerplate, NOT an IP transfer); No-reverse-engineering, no-warranty, or counterparts boilerplate.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, D1.provision.exclusions_x4] All FOUR standard exclusions present; [critical, D1.provision.injunctive_no_bond] Injunctive relief WITHOUT bond/surety requirement (frequently dropped); [major, D1.provision.no_residuals] No-residuals clause present (rarely in default templates); [minor, D1.provision.survival_3y] Survival duration explicitly stated as 3 years.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Mutual structure — obligations run both directions symmetrically (one-sided = dock); legally coherent and enforceable; [major] Defined terms used consistently.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Complete agreement — recitals, effective date, signature blocks; redline-ready.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
